- [TEMPORAL] Session Date: 2023/05/30 (Tue) 23:42
- [FACT] User inquired about enabling Thrive on Higher Logic.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Thrive is a feature available on the Higher Logic platform that enables organizations to create and manage online communities.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Enabling Thrive on Higher Logic involves a few steps.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Step 1: Log in to your Higher Logic account and navigate to the Admin interface.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Step 2: From the Admin interface, click on the "Features" tab.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Step 3: In the Features tab, search for "Thrive" and click on the "Activate" button next to it.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Step 4: Follow the prompts to complete the activation process, which may include agreeing to terms of service, setting up billing information, and configuring Thrive settings.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Step 5: Once Thrive is activated, you can start setting up your community by creating groups, adding members, and configuring settings to meet your organization's needs.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Thrive may not be available to all Higher Logic customers, as it may be restricted to certain pricing tiers or require additional fees.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] If you're not sure whether Thrive is available to you or need help activating it, you can contact Higher Logic support for assistance.
